description: Get daily reference exchange rates per one unit of a base currency, with observation date and currency codes. Not executable trading quotes. ECB source data is also available free from ecb.europa.eu. Costs $0.003. Returns payment instructions for the Saylor endpoint; no provider account required.

base.description: Three-letter currency code supported by the ECB reference-rate feed, for example USD or EUR.

name: get_fx_report
title: Reference Exchange Rates
